summary: Both phases delivered their stated objectives. Phase-01 introduced renderReportPath and FileSystemPort.realpath exactly as planned, with all fakes widened and the audit pipeline left unwired. Phase-02 flipped capability.ts to workspace-anchored paths, deleted repoRoot from the composition root, rippled the field rename through all dependent sites, and added all three required red-first e2e proofs plus application-layer unit tests. One minor deviation in phase-02: composition/index.test.ts had only the one test that was slated for removal, leaving nothing else to keep; rather than leave the file vacuous the implementation replaced it with a minimal smoke test. The handoff documents this decision. All invariance suites passed unmodified.

findings.message: composition/index.test.ts: plan said 'drop the repoRoot-resolves test, keep the rest', but the file contained exactly one test (the one being dropped), so there was nothing else to keep. Instead of leaving the file vacuous, the implementation replaced it with a minimal smoke test asserting the three wired ports are defined. Outcome is functionally identical; deviation is documented in the handoff.

attentionPoints: composition/index.test.ts smoke test: the plan said 'keep the rest' after dropping the repoRoot test. Since there were no other tests, a new smoke test was written instead. Human reviewers should confirm the replacement is appropriate.

ref.manifestAbsPath realpath skipped: the implementation relies on the node package resolver already producing real paths for manifestAbsPath and does not call deps.fs.realpath on it separately. Reviewers may wish to verify this invariant holds for all resolver code paths.
